headline: London's Largest Rooftop Solar Array Powers Historic Market
meta_description: A sprawling East London fruit and vegetable market harnesses the sun with 2,730 solar panels across five rooftops, cutting energy costs and emissions.
summary_short: London's biggest rooftop solar project now powers a 13-hectare market in Leyton, spreading 2,730 panels across five roofs to slash energy bills and carbon output.
body:
London's largest rooftop solar installation is now operational at a major fruit and vegetable market in Leyton, East London. The 2,730-panel project spreads across five roofs of the sprawling 13-hectare market, capturing sunlight to power daily operations.

The installation represents a practical climate solution at an urban scale—transforming an existing commercial space without requiring new land. By harnessing solar energy, the market will significantly reduce its energy costs while cutting greenhouse gas emissions from its operations.

The project demonstrates how established community infrastructure can adapt to meet modern sustainability goals, turning the market's extensive roofscape into a generator of clean power.
quick_facts: 2,730 solar panels installed across five rooftops
London's largest rooftop solar project to date
Reduces energy costs and carbon emissions at once
